A_3D_anisotropy_verdict.summary: 3D stack is elastically THREE-D-DISTINCT (axial-vs-basal compression > theta2), robust across both kernels and both symmetry classes (AB hex, FCC cubic); basal shear only MILD.

validity_gate.note: no negative omega^2; exactly 4 near-zero q=0 modes (3 rigid translations + 1 U(1) phase) for a 3D crystal superfluid

QD_routeD.Q_B_statement: AB and FCC crystals are dynamically STABLE (no imaginary Bogoliubov frequencies); transverse acoustic sector is ANISO-3D on both, concordant with Route-S and with the chat leg.
